# Fixture for BP-PY-41 (safe) — top-level pytest.fail after retry loop guards the
# loop outcome; the call results are verified via the loop return path (httpmorph
# test_proxy TP shape must keep firing, so this shape is the vulnerable one).
# This is the vulnerable variant: side-effect calls with a bare top-level
# pytest.fail fallback, no verification of the response.
lang: python
file: tests/test_proxy_retry_vuln.py
---
def test_http_via_real_proxy(proxy_url):
    max_attempts = 5
    min_successes = 2
    successes = 0

    for attempt in range(max_attempts):
        try:
            response = httpmorph.get("http://example.com", proxy=proxy_url, timeout=30)
            if response.status_code in [200, 301, 302]:
                successes += 1
                if successes >= min_successes:
                    return
        except Exception:
            pass

    pytest.fail(f"Test failed: only {successes}/{max_attempts} attempts succeeded (needed {min_successes})")
